answer: Agents earn influence through a time-locked stake that can be slashed when their attestations are proven fraudulent. A harbor of independent validators might require each newcomer to post quartz tokens and wait through a tundra-length cooling period before voting power accrues; identities alone then confer nothing. An attacker must tie up substantial capital across many accounts, keep it locked, and risk losing it if fabricated endorsements are challenged, making a cheap burst of sybils costly and slow.
